Loop workflow summaries and min-max figures¶

This public tutorial includes explanations, command examples and embedded figures. Command paths refer to the final_code3 analysis-code checkout. Scientific inputs and native software environments are configured separately.

This tutorial describes how the saved metric tables become Fig. 5g, Fig. 6d and Supplementary Fig. 7. It follows the repository's adopted min-max implementation and shows the retained figures. Reading the notebook does not run callers, regenerate figures or load input tables.

The Loop tutorial explains how the individual metrics are obtained. The commands below start from their selected summary CSVs.

Use the shared path setup for the commands below:

source tutorials/paths.sh
cd "${BENCHMARK_ROOT}/code"

from pathlib import Path
import os

BENCHMARK_ROOT = Path(os.environ["BENCHMARK_ROOT"])

1. Metric tables and scoring¶

1.1. Select the comparison and metric tables¶

Panel Compared workflows Saved output directory
Fig. 5g Six native workflows result/native_minmax/
Fig. 6d All 25 workflows scored, top ten displayed result/minmax/
Supplementary Fig. 7 The same full set of 25 workflows result/minmax/

The six native workflows are FitHiC2/Raw, HICCUPS/Raw, HiCFoundation/Raw, Mustache/Raw, Peakachu/Raw and scHiCluster/scHiCluster. Their normalization uses that six-workflow comparison. Fig. 6d and Supplementary Fig. 7 share a separate 25-workflow comparison.

Each comparison uses selected count/Dice, APA, mCG and MouseBrain RNA tables. Their paths and hashes are recorded in the input and output manifests. The figure guide (Loop figure tutorial) lists the required fields.

1.2. Transform and normalize original values¶

First transform Loop num as log10(N + 1). Within each dataset, normalize Loop num, mapped-reference Dice and APA across the panel's workflow set:

import numpy as np

loop_num_transformed = np.log10(loop_num + 1)
normalized = (values - values.min()) / (values.max() - values.min())

The code averages each normalized component equally over the available datasets. Mean mCG correlation is negated before scaling; mean MouseBrain RNA correlation keeps its original direction. Observed constant columns receive

  1. Missing values retain the conventions recorded in the implementation. Ranks displayed inside bars are annotations, separate from the score.

1.3. Apply the five fixed weights¶

Component Weight
Loop num 0.25
Mapped-reference Dice concordance 0.15
APA P2LL 0.25
mCG correlation 0.20
RNA correlation 0.15

The weighted sum determines row order. Fig. 6d selects its ten rows only after all 25 workflows have been scored. Supplementary Fig. 7 displays the full order from the same calculation.

The shared implementation (call_loop/tool/plots/loop_minmax.py in the code repository) writes component scores, per-dataset values, final scores and display ranks as separate tables. The retained figure code preserves conditional Arial selection and PDF/PS Type 42 fonts:

from matplotlib import rcParams, font_manager
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

if "Arial" in [font.name for font in font_manager.fontManager.ttflist]:
    rcParams["font.family"] = "Arial"

plt.rcParams["pdf.fonttype"] = 42
plt.rcParams["ps.fonttype"] = 42

2. Generate and inspect figures¶

2.1. Generate the figures from selected summary inputs¶

Run from the repository root with the Loop evaluation environment:

python call_loop/tool/plots/plot_loop_native_minmax.py \
  --count-dice "${BENCHMARK_ROOT}/records/data/loop_native_minmax/merged_raw_count_f1_ranked.csv" --apa "${BENCHMARK_ROOT}/records/data/loop_native_minmax/APA_summary_all_cell_lines.tsv" \
  --mcg "${BENCHMARK_ROOT}/records/data/loop_native_minmax/lee2019_cg_raw_diffloop.csv" --rna "${BENCHMARK_ROOT}/records/data/loop_minmax/mousebrain_rna_impute_diffloop.csv" --no-show
python call_loop/tool/plots/plot_loop_minmax.py \
  --count-dice "${BENCHMARK_ROOT}/records/data/loop_minmax/merged_count_f1_ranked.csv" --apa "${BENCHMARK_ROOT}/records/data/loop_minmax/APA_impute_all_cell_lines.csv" \
  --mcg "${BENCHMARK_ROOT}/records/data/loop_minmax/lee2019_cg_impute_diffloop.csv" --rna "${BENCHMARK_ROOT}/records/data/loop_minmax/mousebrain_rna_impute_diffloop.csv" \
  --panel both --no-show

Provide the selected metric tables explicitly. To save another complete comparison and keep its outputs separate:

python call_loop/tool/plots/plot_loop_minmax.py \
  --count-dice "${BENCHMARK_ROOT}/records/data/loop_minmax/merged_count_f1_ranked.csv" \
  --apa "${BENCHMARK_ROOT}/records/data/loop_minmax/APA_impute_all_cell_lines.csv" --mcg "${BENCHMARK_ROOT}/records/data/loop_minmax/lee2019_cg_impute_diffloop.csv" \
  --rna "${BENCHMARK_ROOT}/records/data/loop_minmax/mousebrain_rna_impute_diffloop.csv" \
  --output-dir "$FIGURE_OUTPUT_DIR" --panel both --no-show

These commands regenerate summary figures from metrics. Native loop calling and metric calculation are the preceding stages in the Loop tutorial.

3.2. Software and implementation¶

Separate figure regeneration uses Python with NumPy, pandas and Matplotlib, as documented in call_loop/ENVIRONMENT.md in the analysis repository. The shared scoring code is call_loop/tool/plots/loop_minmax.py; native and 25-workflow figure entry scripts are in the same directory. Existing image bytes are embedded here so the saved panels can be read independently of those files.
